The weights for each pickup dropping are the same as they are in light sources. Any multiplier to such weights will also apply to Hail from the Future (X), including its own multiplier for
Gold Fingers, multiplying their weight by 10.

A maximum of seven Candyboxes and Arma Dios can be generated by Hail from the Future (X) in a single run. The base chances of a Candybox and Arma Dio are 2.5% each. When either item is summoned, this chance is divided by the total number of that item spawned. These chances are affected by
For example, if 3 Candyboxes have been summoned, then the 4th will have a base chance of ~0.625% to be granted.
Up to 5 dice, or drops, can be summoned per level. A random value is multiplied by the higher value between the player's level divided by 40, and
. Then, the lower value between this final value and 5 is chosen for the number of drops. Thus, as the player levels up and accumulates Amount, they will be more likely to receive extra drops.
